column1: # deploy/inventory.tsv - THE list of testbed nodes. Every script reads this file
# (scripts/lib/inventory.sh); no script hard-codes a node, an IP or an address.
# Columns (TAB-separated; '-' = empty):
#   name      short node name, also the image tag prefix (mouazkass/om2m-sui-in:<name>-v8)
#   host      hostname on the LAN
#   ip        LAN address (reachable from the laptop over the campus VPN)
#   mac       eth0 MAC
#   role      in-cse | mn-cse   (on-chain identity role; every node runs cseType=in-cse for failover)
#   cse_id    the cse_id string registered on-chain (identity::register)
#   das       yes = the DAS / GRANT node that owns the CapTokens (exactly one)
#   status    pending  = listed, not yet onboarded (no key / not reachable)
#             staged   = key generated on the Pi, address known, not yet registered on-chain
#             active   = registered on-chain, own trust AdminCap, deployed (in the mesh and in every loop)
#   sui_address  the node's own Sui address (its key never leaves the Pi)
# Only scripts/onboard_node.sh changes a row's status/address (scripts/lib/inventory.sh inv_set).
name
